basic_info.description: Step into modern elegance at 742 34th Avenue, a fully renovated home in San Francisco's coveted Richmond District. This 3-bedroom, 5-bathroom (3-full bath-2 powder rooms) residence showcases a bright modern layout, upscale finishes, and thoughtful design throughout.  The upper-level features two generously sized bedrooms, including a stunning primary suite with an oversized spa-inspired bathroom and a walk-in closet with custom-made cabinetry. A second master bedroom with full bath and stylish powder room completes the floor, along with the open concept living room, dining area with a chef's kitchen boasting a large island, high-end appliances, and custom finishes.  The lower level offers a spacious family room, a private third-bedroom suite, a second powder room, and direct access to a beautifully landscaped backyardideal for entertaining or relaxing.  With all-new plumbing, electrical, radiant heat, roof, windows, and doors, this turnkey home offers luxury, comfort, and modern efficiency in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
